items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he came over from Jeff and he and I did a number together, you know?

ctx.x: So I was in school, and I met a guy that was going to Jefferson High School, and I was going to Lafayette Junior High School, and so because he was a real good dancer, and we had an assembly at Lafayette, and he came over from Jeff and he and I did a number together, you know? And I told Curtis Mosby about him, and then it was
all right; I'd gotten away with it. You know, but then the Labor Commission came down on the club and made me quit working, so that's ...
